subject: SIG/CAIQ intake and parallel ISO + FedRAMP audit windows
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@bluerocksec.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake & parallel FedRAMP/ISO audit windows

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the intro last week. BlueRock is scoped to run a combined assurance intake for Acme Health and they asked us to confirm Redwood's readiness for a couple of checkpoints: SIG/CAIQ questionnaire completion, an ISO 27001 evidence sprint, and a FedRAMP dry-run to validate controls and sampling. Before we build a mutual action plan, can you confirm the following?

- Primary scope: are we confirming Redwood-managed inference runtime (hosted & dedicated) + private deployment connectors? Any service or repo excluded?
- Snapshot windows: what typical 7-day snapshot windows can you provide for API logs, IAM events, and KMS access logs? We need at least one contiguous week and a second non-overlapping week for sampling.
- CAIQ/SIG: do you want us to work from your CAIQ export or do you prefer we provide the questionnaire for you to fill?
- Evidence owners: who owns encryption/KMS, access reviews, change control, and data retention artifacts?
- 3P attestations: names and contact for any third-party vendors with attestation artifacts (e.g., cloud provider, monitoring, WAF).

If helpful I attached a short statement of work and intake checklist. If we can get scope + owners by EOD Monday, we can draft a MAP and slot a dry-run in the Oct 19–23 window.

Regards,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Assuror, BlueRock Security
Alicia Gomez | BlueRock Security
(alicia@bluerocksec.com)
Attachment: intro_SOW.pdf (1 page)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@bluerocksec.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake & parallel FedRAMP/ISO audit windows

Hi Alicia —

Thanks — we can support a parallel intake for ISO + FedRAMP dry-run. Quick answers below and a proposed owners list to accelerate the MAP:

Scope:
- Primary: Redwood hosted runtime (API), Redwood Dedicated pools, and Redwood Private connector adapters.
- Excluded: customer-managed on-prem model execution (not part of Redwood control boundary) — we'll call that out in the MAP.

Snapshot windows we can offer (prelim):
- API request/response logs: weeks of 2026-10-11 through 2026-10-17 and 2026-09-13 through 2026-09-19 (UTC snapshots).
- IAM events (console/API): same weeks; retention/export available as csv/json.
- KMS access logs (provider + Redwood audit trail): available but with RBAC masking; expect full key-use events for those two weeks.

CAIQ format: we'll accept your CAIQ template; if you prefer we can export our latest CAIQ v3 with embedded references.

Proposed internal owners (please @ them for confirmation):
- Encryption/KMS: Olga Petrov
- Change control & deploy logs: Priyom Das
- Control narratives & policy artifacts: Markus Klein
- Evidence intake & sample packaging: Mina Haddad

I attached a first-pass evidence catalog to speed matching — Olga/Markus/Priyom/Mina, can you confirm capacity to own these items and whether the snapshot weeks above are workable?

Next steps: once we confirm owners, I’ll draft a 3-week MAP (intake, dry-run, artifact handoff) and share for signature.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_evidence_catalog_v1.xlsx (workbook)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@bluerocksec.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@acmehealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake & parallel FedRAMP/ISO audit windows

Hannah —

Appreciate the quick reply and the owners list. A couple of clarifying points before you draft the MAP:

- CAIQ: we'll send a CAIQ v3 bundle to Hannah and Olga to complete. If you can return it with references to the evidence catalog rows, that will speed processing.
- Snapshot timing: Oct 11–17 works for us as the primary week; for the secondary week we prefer Sep 13–19 as a holdback. Please confirm timezone (we’ll process in UTC).
- API logs format: is there a canonical export schema you can provide? If not, we’ll accept gzip'd jsonl.
- SOC 2: Acme also asked whether you can provide SOC 2 Type II scope docs or if they should rely solely on the CAIQ + ISO evidence for control validation.

If you can draft a MAP with milestone dates and owners, we’ll route a scoped SOW and a DocuSign for signature. We’ll need a HubSpot intake link for tracking as well (if you have one).

Thanks — I’ll await your MAP.
Alicia

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@bluerocksec.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ intake & parallel FedRAMP/ISO audit windows

Alicia —

Draft MAP attached and pasted below. Key notes in-line; Olga/Markus/Priyom/Mina please confirm owners and any blockers by EOD Monday.

--- DRAFT MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (high level) ---
Week 0 (2026-10-04 to 2026-10-10): Intake and CAIQ mapping
- BlueRock: send CAIQ v3 bundle (Alicia) — due 2026-10-05
- Redwood: return CAIQ with evidence refs + evidence catalog updates — Hannah/Olga — due 2026-10-08

Week 1 (2026-10-11 to 2026-10-17): Primary snapshot week (API, IAM, KMS)
- Redwood: deliver gzipped jsonl of API logs and IAM events, KMS key-use events — Priyom/Olga — deliver by 2026-10-18
- BlueRock: begin dry-run sampling and control test cases — Alicia — 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-23

Week 2 (2026-10-25 to 2026-10-31): Evidence packaging and policy walkthroughs
- Redwood: control narratives, change control artifacts, retention policies — Markus/Mina — due 2026-10-27
- BlueRock: validate artifacts and return preliminary gaps — Alicia — due 2026-10-30

Fallbacks/Notes:
- If KMS key export restrictions delay full key-use logs, we will provide signed KMS assertion + cloud provider audit snapshot and targeted HSM logs.
- SOC 2: if Acme requires SOC 2 Type II, we can provide our current Type II report under NDA — Hannah to confirm.

Attachments included: MAP-draft-20261008.docx, SIG-CAIQ-access-instructions.txt

Olga/Markus/Priyom/Mina — please reply with confirmations or blockers. If no blockers, I’ll finalize and request BlueRock DocuSign by 10/12.

Thanks,
Hannah
Attachment: MAP-draft-20261008.docx (docx)
Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-access-instructions.txt (text)

Markus
